snapshot.cross_check: $1.2450 last trade on Kraken, 3:23 AM MDT (Kraken 24h range $1.2267 to $1.2608)

confirmed: XRP is about $1.25 early Saturday, down about 1.0% over 24 hours, about 4.1% lower than 7 days ago and about 17% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:22 AM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.2450, 24h range $1.2267 to $1.2608). Trading has been quieter after Thursday's Binance-driven selloff; bitcoin is near $77,000.

Binance hack update: co-CEO Richard Teng said Oct 30 that investigators found more breach points than a single compromised laptop, that the attacker abused Ethereum's EIP-7702 delegation feature to control a hot wallet, and that Binance is targeting a withdrawal restart by Sunday, Nov 1, after security testing, with a full proof-of-reserves report Monday, Nov 2 (CoinDesk, BBC, TokenPost). Binance says it has reserved more than $6.34B to cover the roughly $6.3B loss; about $3B is frozen on-chain. The US Secret Service says it is helping trace the funds and the FBI says it is aware (BBC). Deposits are working; withdrawals are still paused.

Wall Street had a rough Friday: the S&P 500 fell 1.82% to 7,580.07 and the Dow fell 1.09% on Oct 30 (AP). That followed Oct 29 data showing Q3 GDP up 3.4% and core PCE inflation at 3.1%, and the Fed's Oct 28 hold at 3.75% to 4.00% with two members wanting a hike.

Ripple and Coinbase announced today that RLUSD can now be traded and held in the Coinbase app, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Prime, with 1:1 conversion from dollars, and deposits and withdrawals on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum (Ripple, Oct 28). This is about the RLUSD stablecoin, not an XRP listing change.

Moody's rated RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term on Oct 27, citing reserves mostly in short-term US government assets and cash held at BNY, with a 103% coverage target; it also flagged that holders don't yet have a direct claim on reserves (Moody's, Decrypt, The Block). Ripple separately said it is on track for about a $900M annual product revenue run rate (Ripple, Oct 28), and Garlinghouse said on stage, 'We will never give up on XRP' (U.Today).

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals. Reported independently by The Block and Cointelegraph.

C2FO and Ripple will bring settlement for C2FO's new Instant Pay product onto the XRP Ledger, using RLUSD, so suppliers paid early get funds in seconds instead of days (Ripple, Oct 27). Settlement is in RLUSD, not XRP.

Ripple and Robinhood partnership: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood and is expected in the Robinhood app later in 2026, with no launch date or eligible states announced yet; Robinhood plans institutional settlement in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, also with no start date (Ripple, Cointelegraph, CryptoSlate Oct 28).

Ripple's national trust bank got final OCC approval (announced Oct 26). It will manage RLUSD reserves and offer business custody; it cannot take deposits or make loans. Treasury Secretary Bessent appeared with Garlinghouse at Swell on Oct 27 and spoke about stablecoins and dollar strength broadly, not XRP specifically.

US spot XRP ETFs had a small net outflow of about $497K on Oct 30: Canary's XRPC took in $922K and Grayscale's GXRP lost $725K. That came after an $8.43M inflow on Oct 29. Cumulative net inflows are about $1.81B and total net assets about $1.42B (SoSoValue via ChainCatcher).

Swell wrapped up Oct 29 in New York. Garlinghouse said Ripple will prioritize XRP 'any place it makes sense' while also using RLUSD and fiat, and set a five-year ambition for XRP to become a standard for institutional payment rails; he gave no price target (TokenPost, FXStreet citing Bloomberg). Separately, XRP Ledger developers proposed a fixCleanup3_5_0 upgrade tightening rules for 'restricted' tokens; it is not active on mainnet (CoinDesk).

Maple Finance's own disclosures show about 225 million XRP pledged as collateral for three stablecoin loans totaling about $151.8M, due Dec 4, Dec 12 and Jan 15. Displayed collateral levels are about 178% to 188%, and no margin call or liquidation is reported; a maturity can end in repayment or refinancing, not necessarily a sale (CryptoSlate, TokenPost).

Ripple's regular monthly escrow release of up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled for Nov 1 (6 PM MDT Oct 31). This is routine, not new. An XRP Ledger bug fix (fixCleanup3_4_0) is expected to activate about Nov 4 if validator support holds.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. The '3.7 million XRPL transactions in a day' figure is real but is from Oct 25, after an unusually low Oct 24, so it is not new. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal; no BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion in XRP transfers overnight' or 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1. 'Binance XRP open interest CRASHED 28%' posts describe a real CryptoQuant figure, but it is a decline over five weeks (since Sept 22), partly because XRP's price fell, not a sudden crash today. 'XRP holders will get paid just for being active on X, starting next week' names no developer and no program and matches engagement-bait patterns. 'Ripple moved 220 million XRP' posts describe on-chain transfers between Ripple-labelled wallets with no stated purpose; internal moves are common before the Nov 1 escrow release and are not a sale. '17 of the biggest banks are live on SWIFT's ledger' is a Great Reset-style claim with no XRP link shown. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.25 on every major venue. 'XRP holder accumulation jumped from 1M to 190M XRP in two weeks' gives no source or wallet definition. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. Price 'what if' posts are speculation with no source. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'XRP eyes a new all-time high' posts give no source; XRP is near $1.25, down about 17% in 30 days. 'Canary ETF clients bought $922K of XRP' is accurate for one fund, but total XRP ETF flows were a small net outflow that day. 'Uphold just launched XRP inheritance' is real but dates to Sept 29, not new. Maple's XRP-backed loans are real, but 'forced token sales' is not established. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Maple locks $280M in XRP collateral and upcoming maturity dates threaten liquidations
news.summary: Maple's disclosures show about 225M XRP backing three loans with about $151.8M in principal due in December and January. Maturities can end in repayment or refinancing; no margin call is reported.

news.headline: US XRP and ZEC spot ETFs record a $5.07M combined net outflow
news.summary: SoSoValue data for Oct 30: XRP ETFs net outflow about $497K (Canary +$922K, Grayscale −$725K); cumulative inflow $1.809B, net assets $1.419B.

news.headline: Binance discovers multiple breach points in $6.3 billion attack, eyes Sunday reopening
news.summary: Teng says the attacker used EIP-7702 delegation to control a hot wallet, Binance has reserved more than $6.34B, and withdrawals should return by Sunday if testing passes. A full proof-of-reserves report is planned for Monday.

news.headline: Binance hack updates: US Secret Service helping to track stolen funds
news.summary: The Secret Service says investigators are working around the clock to trace and recover funds; the FBI says it is aware. Withdrawals stay off until they pass rigorous testing.

news.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Friday 10/30/2026
news.summary: The S&P 500 fell 140.32 points (1.82%) to 7,580.07 and the Dow fell 572.25 points (1.09%) to 51,770.31.

news.headline: Binance Targets Nov. 1 Withdrawal Restart, Plans Reserve Report
news.summary: Deposits work normally; withdrawals remain suspended. The Nov 1 target depends on completing security tests, so it is not a guarantee.

news.headline: Important Ripple News and XRP Price Update: October 30
news.summary: Weekly recap of Swell announcements (Coinbase, Robinhood, BNY, Moody's, OCC). Notes XRP hit a multi-month low near $1.19 during the Binance selloff.

news.headline: Binance's $6.3 billion hack: What we know and what comes next
news.summary: TRM Labs links the attack with high confidence to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. A Fundstrat strategist says it does not currently appear to pose a significant solvency risk for Binance; the key tell is how quickly withdrawals resume.

news.headline: Binance says its $6.3bn hack involved more than a compromised laptop
news.summary: Citing TRM Labs: most funds left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes across ten chains, including the XRP Ledger. Deposits are operating normally; withdrawals are on track to resume after a security revamp.

news.headline: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
news.summary: Four proposed changes bundled as fixCleanup3_5_0 would close loopholes in issuer approval for regulated tokens such as stablecoins and tokenized funds. None is active on mainnet yet.

news.headline: XRP drops 6% despite Ripple's projected $900M annualized revenue
news.summary: Garlinghouse told Bloomberg XRP is 'at the heart of everything Ripple does' and remains a bridge asset; XRP was testing support near $1.24. Technical levels are analysis, not a forecast.

news.headline: Security Incident Update
news.summary: Binance estimates the incident's impact at about $6.3B, says about $3B is frozen on-chain, found no evidence of a private key leak, suspended deposits and withdrawals as a precaution, and will cover all losses from SAFU and company funds.

news.headline: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history
news.summary: About half of the $6.3B was frozen; the hack eclipses the $1.5B Bybit theft of 2025. Co-CEO Richard Teng says it was a complex attack, not one engineer's permissions.

news.headline: Coinbase (COIN) earnings Q3 2026
news.summary: Revenue of $1.20B trailed estimates; adjusted net income of $719M was lifted by gains in Coinbase's crypto investment portfolio.

news.headline: Ripple CEO Sets Five-Year Goal for XRP as Schwartz Sees Retail Blockchain Use
news.summary: Garlinghouse at Swell: Ripple will prioritize XRP where it fits a transaction and use RLUSD or fiat elsewhere. No price target or XRP share of volume was given.

news.headline: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as Samsung-led tech jitters and a hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
news.summary: Bitcoin fell from above $81,700 to about $79,800 in Asian trading after Samsung shares dropped more than 5% on a chip-unit miss; XRP, ETH and SOL fell with it. About $356M of futures were liquidated in 24 hours, $205M of it longs.

news.headline: Ripple is heading for its best year ever while XRP faces its worst since 2022
news.summary: Contrasts Ripple's approaching $900M revenue run rate and 1,700+ institutional customers with XRP's roughly 29% loss in 2026 (CryptoRank), raising the question of when XRPL adoption shows up as token demand.

news.headline: Ripple and Stellar outlook: XRP and XLM lose ground as hawkish Fed tone weighs
news.summary: XRP is testing support near $1.30 after the Fed hold, below its 50, 100 and 200-day moving averages. Technical analysis only, not a forecast.

news.headline: Ripple CEO Addresses the One Rumor XRP Holders Kept Asking About
news.summary: Second outlet confirming Garlinghouse's Swell remarks: 'We will never give up on XRP,' with RLUSD described as complementary rather than a rival.
